verdict.rationale: Plaid is API-first. Its core products (Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Payments) are all exposed through the API and SDKs, with webhooks for async state. Sandbox Items can be created purely via API with /sandbox/public_token/create. A hosted Dashboard MCP server also exposes some Dashboard functions (Item debugging, Link conversion, usage metrics) to agents. However, Link flow customization is documented as a Dashboard action, API keys are obtained by signing up in the Dashboard, and no OpenAPI spec was found at common paths. Missing for 10: API equivalents for Dashboard-only tasks (Link customization, account signup and key provisioning), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and explicit documentation of API/UI parity.
